{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
data['revenue'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Filter out refunded orders: only include 'completed' status for conversion rate
completed_data = data[data['status'] == 'completed']

# Verify no refunded orders remain
assert (completed_data['status'] == 'refunded').sum() == 0, "Refunded orders still in completed_data"

# Compute conversion rates by channel
channel_conversion = completed_data.groupby('channel')['converted'].mean()

# Extract rates
email_rate = channel_conversion['email']
paid_search_rate = channel_conversion['paid_search']

difference = email_rate - paid_search_rate

# Final evidence: all values printed
print(f"completed_data shape: {completed_data.shape}")
print(f"Conversion rate (email): {email_rate}")
print(f"Conversion rate (paid_search): {paid_search_rate}")
print(f"Difference (email - paid_search): {difference}")

# Confirm the question's premise: two channels
print(f"Channels present: {sorted(completed_data['channel'].unique())}")"}
